text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but I should base sales on my portfolio plan rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains.","My account declined substantially over several periods, so I should monitor overall risk and diversification instead of letting losses or attachment to individual holdings delay a review.","I rarely trade, and holding can be sensible; still, I should check my positions periodically and make deliberate changes when they no longer fit my goals."]}
